subject: Quarter-end: Balance Playbook & Stage Cleanup
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme-analytics.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter-end: Balance Playbook & Stage Cleanup

Team / Acme procurement – quick playbook to make the next 48 hours predictable for invoicing and commit clarity. I attached a working spreadsheet (EOQ_Balance_Playbook_v1.xlsx) and a fast stage snapshot (stage_snapshot_20270630.csv). Please read the short asks below and reply with the single-line confirmations.

High-level asks (48‑hour window):
- Stage updates: owners to confirm whether opps are Green / Yellow / At-risk and whether legal/finance gating items are outstanding. Reply format: <OPP-ID> — <Stage> — <Commit?> — < blocker short code>.
- Commit confirmation: For any deals showing 'commit' in CRM, confirm PO or signed SOW by EOD Fri (2027-07-02 PST). If PO is pending, include expected PO approval date.
- Final invoice terms: Acme — if you have special billing cadence or invoicing address changes, share immediately so finance can line up invoices and tax forms.

Priority owners:
- Monica: primary on stage snapshots and consolidated status (I’ve asked you to consolidate updates into tab "StageRollup").
- Laura: finance gate owner — confirm licensing tiers and invoice flow for any ACME committed orders.
- Priyom: discounts/commit concessions — log any non-standard credits so we can clear approvals.

Immediate next steps (please):
1) Monica — update StageRollup tab and drop a one-line comment for each opp that transitions stage or changes commit status.
2) Acme procurement / Sara — confirm if the PO referenced in the snapshot (PO# 68321) is final or needs amendments (if final, please attach).
3) Laura — confirm invoice recipient and whether we need a separate SOW routing.

Attachments: EOQ_Balance_Playbook_v1.xlsx (working), stage_snapshot_20270630.csv (export).

Goal: avoid last‑minute recon on Friday and ensure finance can invoice on Monday without surprises. Short replies appreciated — this is intentionally tight.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme-analytics.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-end: Balance Playbook & Stage Cleanup

Thanks David — on it. Quick notes from my side after a first pass on the snapshot:
- OPP-ACME-117: Stage moved to "Commit" earlier today; PO 68321 referenced in snapshot is draft (procurement asked for two line-item clarifications). Monica to confirm if procurement sends final by Thu EOD.
- OPP-ACME-123: Still "Proposal" — legal redline pending; Priyom flagged 10% discount that needs ACK from finance.
- OPP-ACME-138: Marking "At-risk" due to procurement budget cycle mismatch; moved to Yellow on the rollup.

I attached a short PDF export of the ACME PO statuses (ACME_PO_status.pdf) with my inline comments. I will update the StageRollup tab with one-line confirmations for each opp by 2pm PT today and ping owners where I need the final numbers.

Action bullets for this thread:
- Monica: populate StageRollup by 14:00 PT today (I’ll include short comments).
- Priyom: confirm whether the 10% discount on OPP-ACME-123 is pre-approved or needs exec sign-off.
- Laura: please confirm invoicing workflow for PO 68321 draft vs final.

Monica
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme-analytics.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-end: Balance Playbook & Stage Cleanup

David / team — thanks for the clarity. Procurement here — quick responses:
- PO 68321: The version Monica saw is a draft. We expect the approved PO to land on Fri 2027-07-02 before close of business. I’ve attached the internal confirmation in our system to procurement@acme-analytics.com (copy).
- Invoice terms: Standard net-30. Invoice should be sent to accounting@acme-analytics.com with our PO number in the subject line. If you need COD/advance notice, let me know.
- Line-item clarifications: we requested SKU-level descriptions for two of the line items (to match our internal asset tags). If you can provide a brief SKU note, that will speed approvals.

We will aim to have the final PO in place on Friday; if anything slips we’ll notify Monica and David immediately.

—Sara
Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme-analytics.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-end: Balance Playbook & Stage Cleanup

Appreciate the quick turn, Sara. Summary & owners (final):
- Monica: update StageRollup by 2pm PT today (confirmations for OPP-ACME-117/123/138). If PO 68321 arrives, mark OPP-ACME-117 as Invoicable and add PO# to the rollup.
- Laura: wait for PO# then confirm invoice recipient — target to send invoice Mon 2027-07-05 for net-30 terms. If ACME requires a different email or additional tax form, let me know today.
- Priyom: flag any pricing exceptions for OPP-ACME-123 in the rollup; if exec sign-off is required, route via me and I’ll escalate.
- Acme procurement/Sara: please deliver final PO by EOD Fri 2027-07-02 where possible; attach to reply or send to procurement@redwoodinference.com.

If anyone needs a short call to unblock, I’m available 12:00–1:30pm PT tomorrow. Otherwise, let’s keep this thread as the single source of truth so Finance can reconcile early next week.

Thanks — short replies preferred; I’ll close the loop once the rollup shows final PO#s.

David
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
